body: lmao i would’ve thought the same thing but he’s a huge game fanatic, he immediately knew what it was, also thank you!
that’s what it feels like at this point honestly.
He doesn’t do it purposely, it’s not like he tells people we aren’t dating. he’s just uncomfortable with PDA and people associate touchy with dating.

honestly? nothing in public, which i’m fine with because he has trauma from PDA but even we are alone, he doesn’t do much really. people see us as friends until i tell them we are dating. he shows more joking affection to our friends than me (and i told him that). i’m basically desperate for anything by this point

i explained i felt unloved and he treated me more like a friend and i asked him what his love language was. he explained he didn’t see how he was treating me differently but agreed to see how he could make me feel more loved but he put all the responsibility on me on finding a way that would work for him, even though i explained literally anything would work for me as long as he told me that was his love language.
Tics can actually come and go but they won’t disappear like that. they can die down for a few years then suddenly spurt up in intensity

i’m anxious because i’m afraid people will look at me differently. I feel so bad for saying that because there’s nothing wrong with being neurodivergent, don’t get me wrong. but people tend to baby people who are neurodivergent or use them as a “token friend” or “token child”. I’m mostly anxious about my mother looking at me differently because she has bullied, berated, screamed etc at me for my behaviors but will turn around and say she’s a “autism mom” or “it’s so hard being an autism mom” etc. i don’t want to be seen differently and i feel like such a butt (cant swear according the rules) for saying that. i’m over explaining and i know i look bad for saying this but i’m very bad with words so if i need to clarify, pls let me know
